title: Nice, color a bit on the purple hue side
text: Nice, color a bit on the purple hue side. I wanted grey to match my bathroom, but this actually has a bit of a purple hue to it. Some people might not notice it, or if you have a bathroom with blue or pink hues, it would probably blend it. But for me, in my grey and green, it kind of stands out as slightly off. I'll have to find something else that matches better in that room. Otherwise, the quality seems ok, it's soft and absorbent enough to get the job done. I just wish the color was more accurate.
